# DIN Calculator

> > Professional ski binding and equipment calculators based on ISO 11088:2006 standards from the Deutsches Institut für Normung (German Institute for Standardization).

DIN Calculator provides safety-focused tools for alpine and touring skiing equipment selection, including DIN binding release force settings, ski sizing, boot fitting, and pole length calculations. The site emphasizes proper equipment configuration to reduce injury risk while accommodating different skiing abilities and styles.

## Key Topics

- DIN (Deutsches Institut für Normung)
- ISO 11088:2006
- Ski binding release force settings
- Alpine skiing equipment
- Ski touring gear selection
- Mondopoint sizing system
- Skiing ability levels
- Equipment sizing calculators
- Binding adjustment
- Ski length calculation
- Touring ski types (classic, free, speed)
- Ski boot fitting
- Safety standards compliance
- Metric measurement systems

## Binding & Safety Calculators

- [Professional DIN Calculator](https://dincalculator.com): DIN setting calculator for ski binding release force (ISO 11088:2006)
- [Professional DIN Calculator (Home)](https://dincalculator.com/index.html): Homepage: DIN binding calculator for safe release force settings

## Ski Equipment Calculators

- [Professional ski size calculator](https://dincalculator.com/assets/ski-size-calculator): Calculate optimal ski length based on height, weight, ability & style
- [How to choose touring skis](https://dincalculator.com/ski-touring/touring-skis-calculator): Touring ski calculator for length, waist width & turning radius selection
- [Professional ski pole length calculator](https://dincalculator.com/assets/ski-pole-length-calculator): Calculate correct ski pole length based on height & skiing style

## Sizing Reference Charts

- [Professional SKI boot size chart](https://dincalculator.com/ski-boot-size-chart-mondopoint-size.html): Ski boot size conversion chart with Mondopoint & European sizing

## Optional

- [How to Choose Travel Insurance for Skiing / Snowboarding](https://dincalculator.com/ski-insurance.html): Guide to ski/snowboard travel insurance covering rescue costs & gear
- [The Ikon pass](https://dincalculator.com/ikon_pass.html): Ikon Pass guide: Alterra Mountain network access & resort info
